title: translations.json — the written form
description: The file a Core writes beside a game and the site publishes. This is the WRITTEN form: what a current Core must produce, and what the site takes at upload without tolerance. Readers are more lenient (see cases.json, `read`), the site's door slightly more so (`upload`). Keys starting with an underscore are metadata; every other key is a line of the game's text, in the source language, translated by the value. Line endings are LF only, in keys and values: every reader normalises CRLF before anything else, and the hash is computed on the normalised form.

_engine_version.description: The placeholder format the lines were written with. 1 = [!v*N] for numbers, [!t*N] for tags, [!STR*N] for variables, [!nl] for a line break. A reader migrates older forms; a Core writes the current one.

_uuid.description: The lineage. Generated once for a new file, kept through download, upload, contribution and update; replaced only by a fork. Every reader that finds none gives the file a fresh one.

_source_language.description: The game's language, as stated by the file. Absent until settled; never "auto" in the written form (a mode is not an answer — a reader hands "auto" over unjudged).

_target_language.description: The language the values are in. Absent until settled.

_local_changes.description: Lines changed since the last sync with the server, recounted against the ancestor at every write. A writer omits it at 0.

_metadata_dirty.description: The settings sections changed since the last sync. A writer omits it when false.

_game.description: Which game the file was written for, as the Core detected it.

name.description: The product name, or the game folder's name when there is none.

steam_id.description: The Steam app id as a string, or null for a game that has none. Never a number.

_source.description: Where the file stands against the server. Written only once the file has met it.

hash.description: The server's file_hash at the last sync (download or upload). Compared with the server's current hash to tell 'up to date' from 'update available'.

main_hash.description: For a branch: the Main's hash at the last merge from it.

site_id.description: The server row of this lineage's line for this account — the only handle an anonymous download keeps.

_forked_from.description: Present on a fork only: where it came from, frozen at the moment of the fork and never recomputed.

resolved_lines.description: How many translated lines were taken, a snapshot at the fork.

content_hash.description: The content taken, without the lineage — what says whether the fork is still the copy. Absent from a fork made before the key existed: 'we cannot tell'.

_fonts.description: Settings section `fonts`: an inventory keyed by font name. Internal shape: a later artefact.

_font_overrides.description: Settings section `font_rules`: ordered, first match wins. Internal shape: a later artefact.

_image_replacements.description: Settings section `images`. Internal shape: a later artefact.

_exclusions.description: Settings section `exclusions`: path patterns whose text is never sent. Internal shape: a later artefact.

_variables.description: Settings section `variables`: game values lifted out of texts as [!STR*N]. Internal shape: a later artefact.

_settings.description: Settings section `game_settings`: per-game switches. Internal shape: a later artefact.

propertyNames.$comment: LF only: a key holding CR is not the written form. Every reader normalises CRLF, so a Core that writes it has keys the site never finds.

not.$comment: At least one line: a file made only of metadata has nothing to publish and is refused at the door.

uuid.description: A lowercase GUID. The site's door is wider ([A-Za-z0-9-]{1,36}) for files written before this was fixed; a Core writes a GUID.

hash.description: SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex digits, no prefix.

language.description: A language name exactly as catalogs/languages.json spells it (the name IS the upload contract).

line.description: One line: the key is the game's text, the value what to show instead.

v.description: The translation, LF only. Empty or null = a capture waiting for one (with t = H), or a line the model declined (with t = S, where v then repeats the key).

t.description: Who wrote it: H a human, V a human validated a machine's, A a machine, S skipped (not in the source language; v = the key), M the mod's own interface — legacy in this file, interface lines live in modui-translate.json and a reader takes them out.

i.description: Capture order, for the web editors to sort by. Omitted when absent, never null. Presentation only: excluded from every hash and every merge comparison.
